items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: Now you’ve got to remember I got many of those guys like Richie Cole and, you know, they were all friends of mine and had been with me with the Dues Band.

ctx.x: Were you there when they first read it?

I sure was. At the end of the week they do the Sunday afternoon show, You know what that means, they’ll play one set at 2. And I brought all the charts out. It was cold, it was one of those winter days. I had a long scarf around me and all that sort of thing and I knew I better have “Mercy” done. That’s the only one that really mattered to him at that point. And the place, Lennie’s on the Turnpike, Route 1 — I guess that would be Topsfield, and I walked into the door. The band is right here, all playing and he’s…
What was the reaction to the first reading of “Mercy Mercy” at Lennie’s on the Turnpike?
